digest.component_or_area: snapshot entry immutability and reducer cache
propositions: Snapshot entries in <store>/tickets-<sha>/ are documented as immutable and content-addressed but are mutated by every ticket read which writes .cache.json inside the entry
The reducer cache write seam (write_cache via atomic_write) publishes derived files into snapshot entries during read operations through a pinned tracker root, violating immutability
Entry immutability breakage blocks safe blob hardlink-sharing between adjacent entries and can corrupt shared inodes if atomic_write ever uses in-place writes instead of rename
The reverify_entry baseline digest becomes stale after reads add .cache.json files, causing false corruption detection on subsequent verification passes
Reading a ticket through a pinned snapshot root must not write into the snapshot entry; the reducer cache should be disabled or redirected outside when the tracker root is a snapshot
